scientific.integrity: The corrigendum full text was inspected at Theorems 1.1-1.2, reduced endemic equation (1.1), and the proof step claiming the weak pointwise condition implies supercriticality. The publication record was checked for date and primary MSC. The equality case is proved independently by an exact Neumann energy identity, and the strict-somewhere case by the principal-eigenvalue Rayleigh test together with the corrigendum theorems. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result classifies only the additional-hypothesis regime of the corrigendum with d_S<d_I and pointwise N/|Omega| at least gamma/beta. It does not resolve uniqueness when that pointwise ordering fails.

title: Exact endemic-existence boundary under a corrected spatial SIS uniqueness hypothesis
